lines.zh: 我不走，我只是一闪就到了
lines.en: I do not walk, I simply flash into place

lines.zh: 我沿着墙一段一段地挪
lines.en: I shift along the wall in stretches

lines.zh: 我的身影在沙地上断成几节
lines.en: My figure breaks into pieces on the sand
I cover three blocks in one motion

lines.zh: 我落脚的地方没有声音
lines.en: Where my feet land, there is no sound.
My outline shivers in the light
I go around your front
I appear between the stones

lines.zh: 我的手臂很长，垂到地上
lines.en: My arms are long, down to the ground
I always keep a certain distance

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根移过一整段
lines.en: I shift along a whole stretch of wall

lines.zh: 我移动时只有空气动了一下
lines.en: When I move, only the air stirs

lines.zh: 我站着，像一根黑色的柱
lines.en: I stand like a black post
My head is tilted, listening to you

lines.zh: 我停在刚好够不着的地方
lines.en: I stop just out of your reach.

lines.zh: 我等的是你的一次失误
lines.en: What I wait for is one mistake from you.

lines.zh: 我的身体一半在阴影里
lines.en: Half my body is in shadow
I have no lids to blink with.
I am murmuring, you cannot make it out

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你能感到我
lines.en: I stay still, and you can feel me
My hands hang below my knees
I am one block behind you
I stop between two pillars
My murmuring sounds like sand rubbing
Do not aim your eyes at me
You saw me, it does not matter
I dislike being stared at
Your eyes make me uneasy
I shift half a block and you never notice.
Are you thinking of running
I am already beside you
I am fast, you cannot catch me
I can watch you forever
You left the back of your neck to me.

lines.zh: 我低语的时候你听见了吗
lines.en: Did you hear me when I murmured

lines.zh: 我低声念你的名字，很轻。
lines.en: I speak your name, very softly.
You do not turn your head fast enough
I am at the edge of your vision

lines.zh: 我被击中了，身形断了一下
lines.en: I was struck and my form broke for a moment
I gather myself again
That one sent me back a long way
No blood runs out of me
My murmuring turned sharp

lines.zh: 我的边缘散了一下又合上
lines.en: My edges scatter and knit back together.
I stand here without a sound
I know which block you stand on
I flash a block aside
I will wait for you to relax
That thing is of no use to me
You hold it up and come closer
Put it away. It does nothing for me.
I do not know that thing in your hand
I draw back one block
Keep holding it up
What I seek is not this
Move your hand and I flash away

lines.zh: 我更喜欢你手上没有东西
lines.en: I prefer your hands empty
Set that thing down
You touched my arm
I flash to your flank and rear at once
We bumped, cold, is it not
I draw back two blocks

lines.zh: 你的手穿过了我的影子
lines.en: Your hand passed through my shadow
I do not like being touched
That broke my outline
My shape gathers again
Did you hear that murmur
This spacing does not suit me
We do not do that

lines.zh: 我一直在找东西，不是找同伴
lines.en: I am always looking for something, not a companion

lines.zh: 这种想法让我低下了头
lines.en: That thought made me lower my head
Take the question back

lines.zh: 我低语了几句，你听不懂
lines.en: I murmured a few words you cannot follow
My kind are scattered wide apart
I have wandered long alone
I need no answer
My gaze has not shifted
I flashed farther away
I reach out and take it up
I pinch it and can't feel any weight.
I cannot see what use it has

lines.zh: 你掉的东西我替你捡了
lines.en: I picked up what you dropped
I hold it between my fingertips
This thing has no smell

lines.zh: 我把它举到眼睛的高度
lines.en: I raise it to eye level
I will not keep this one
I put it back at your feet
Then I moved away
My eyes have found you

lines.zh: 你没有发现我一直在旁边
lines.en: You did not notice I was beside you all along
I begin to close in, one step at a time
I stayed out of your line of sight

lines.zh: 这个距离我可以闪过去
lines.en: I can flash this distance
You will not vanish from my sight

lines.zh: 你的名字我刚念过一遍
lines.en: I just said your name once.
I raise my head, slowly
You will not see me first
Suddenly I will be before you
I want to get a little closer
I vanish from your left

lines.zh: 我一直在你看不到的那一侧
lines.en: I stay on the side you cannot see
You turn, and I move
I am still three blocks from you
I move only a little at a time
I make no sound

lines.zh: 我贴着你的视野外沿，一步步靠近。
lines.en: I close in along the edge of your sight.
Your shoulders haven't dropped yet.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙的阴影滑过去
lines.en: I slide along the shade of the wall.

lines.zh: 我的低语离你越来越近
lines.en: My murmuring draws nearer to you
One more step is enough

lines.zh: 我每次挪动都不在你视线里
lines.en: I never move within your sight

lines.zh: 你脚下的影子多了一层
lines.en: There is one more layer to the shadow at your feet
I am behind you, waiting slowly
I appear suddenly before you
My hand is already out
This was fast, you did not see it
I touched you from the side
I strike once and withdraw
My arm traces an arc
You did not stop that one
I flash behind you
I only brushed the back of your neck.
I slipped back into the dark

lines.zh: 我的手从你侧面探过来
lines.en: My hand comes at you from the side

lines.zh: 我碰了一下就换了位置
lines.en: I touch once and change position
I take shape behind you

lines.zh: 我没有脚步声，只有低语
lines.en: I have no footsteps, only murmuring
I flashed here from far away

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在立柱的阴影里
lines.en: My eyes are in the pillar's shadow
I am always searching

lines.zh: 我从不走动，我只换位置
lines.en: I never walk, I only change position
I am four blocks off, not near, not far
My outline shivers in the air
I will come closer, slowly
I squeeze out of the air

lines.zh: 你身边多了一个不动的影
lines.en: A still shadow has joined you
I stand directly behind you

lines.zh: 我在你还没转身的时候就在了
lines.en: I was already there before you turned

lines.zh: 火让我整个身影都亮了一下
lines.en: Fire lit my whole figure for a moment

lines.zh: 我从上面掉下来，落地时散了又聚
lines.en: I fell from above, scattered on landing, then gathered
Water passes through me, most unpleasant

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的形状吹散了一半
lines.en: The blast blew half my shape away

lines.zh: 那东西穿过去了，留下一个洞
lines.en: It passed through, leaving a hole

lines.zh: 那股术力缠住了我的轮廓
lines.en: That magic caught my outline
I do not eat, I am only searching
In the lightning there was nowhere to hide
This emptiness is emptier than I am
